title: A valid config using every key

fixture_files..kogen/project.yaml:
name: kt
base: main
checks:
  - name: lint
    argv: [sh, checks/lint.sh]
    timeout_ms: 60000
  - name: unit
    argv: [sh, checks/unit.sh]
    timeout_ms: 60000
acceptance_checks:
  - name: syntax
    argv: [sh, -n, "{path}"]
    timeout_ms: 60000
setup:
  - name: setup
    argv: [sh, checks/setup.sh]
    timeout_ms: 60000
setup_outputs: [build]
fix:
  - name: fmt
    argv: [sh, checks/fmt.sh]
    timeout_ms: 60000
format: [sh, checks/fmt.sh]
protected_paths: [Makefile, "docs/**"]
gate_paths: ["checks/*.sh"]
domains:
  app: [lib]
  docs: [docs]
env:
  KT_MODE: test
sandbox: true
acceptance:
  adapter: command
  ext: .t.sh
  candidate_dir: test/acceptance
  run: [sh, run-acceptance.sh, "{path}"]
  timeout_ms: 600000
shaping:
  proof: none
build:
  ladder:
    max_rungs: 3
    experimental_r4: false
  roles:
    builder: {model: gpt-6-luna, effort: max}
    planner: {model: gpt-6.1-sol, effort: high}
    shaper: {model: gpt-6-luna, effort: max}
    fallback_shaper: {model: gpt-6.1-sol, effort: high}
    auditor: {model: gpt-6.1-sol, effort: high}
    rung2: {model: gpt-6.1-sol, effort: medium}
    rung3: {model: gpt-6.1-sol, effort: high}
  land: green-or-advisory
  budget_ms: 3600000
  fallback:
    gpt-6-luna: {model: gpt-6.1-sol, effort: medium}
    gpt-6.1-sol: {model: gpt-6-luna, effort: max}
account: default

stdout_starts_lines: Intent: greet — Greet Almir by name
